snov_prison.updateNotes: Prison breaks now work without the metal shop: with it disabled, yard duty turns up scrap metal that replaces the plates in the shovel recipes. Prisoners are no longer released early after the resource restarts.

snov_stretcher.updateNotes: Conscious patients now stay on the stretcher when it is loaded into a vehicle, instead of falling off and having to get in separately.

snov_importcars.updateNotes: The dealership now runs on plain ESX with every other integration optional, and ships in English and German. When updating, keep your current job and account settings.

snov_cuffs.updateNotes: Using the handcuffs from the hotbar no longer restrains several players in quick succession; there is now a short pause between two arrests.

snov_jobs.updateNotes: Job, boss and admin menus are now available in English and German, and Snov Banking & Billing is now optional. Install together with snov_banking_billing 1.2.0.

snov_elevators.updateNotes: Floors can now restrict which jobs may travel to them, and elevators can be locked out of service entirely.

snov_evidence.updateNotes: Evidence is now available in English and German, following the server's ox_lib language setting. A new optional setting lets civilians dispose of old casings and projectiles.

snov_license.updateNotes: Weapon training at Ammu-Nation is now a written theory exam instead of a simple purchase, graded on the spot with a result breakdown and a non-refundable attempt fee. Passing issues an official stamped certificate into the citizen's inventory, and an NPC reprints lost copies.

snov_banking_billing.updateNotes: Banking is now available in English and German and runs without Snov Jobs. Install together with snov_jobs 2.9.0.

snov_documents.updateNotes: Filing cabinets and mailboxes are rebuilt with named compartments, drag to sort, search across the whole cabinet and one-button deposit. Adds citations as their own paper type and a global power-of-attorney template. Install together with snov_mdt 1.6.0 or newer.

snov_gps.updateNotes: Ambulance and fire now each get their own GPS with green and red markers, and a dispatcher role sees every unit on one map.

snov_ecuffs.updateNotes: Officers can fit an electronic ankle monitor that shows the wearer on their GPS and can be shared with colleagues or the whole department. Install together with snov_gps 1.2.0 or newer.
